prompt_text: Who does backflow testing and repair near Liberty MO?
ai_overview_text:
Certified backflow testing and repair near Liberty, Missouri, is offered by local providers such as Backflow Boss and CertPro Plumbing, LLC. Better Business Bureau +1
Services: Certified backflow testing, on-demand urgent repairs, replacements, and direct digital compliance report submissions to local water authorities.
Phone: (816) 226-8264
Location: Operating out of Liberty, MO
Mandatory Testing: Annual operational tests and certified inspections are required for backflow prevention assemblies connected to Liberty's water system (including lawn irrigation and fire protection lines). City of Liberty, MO (.gov)
Qualifications: Technicians performing the test must carry certification from the Missouri Department of Natural Resources (MODNR). City of Liberty, MO (.gov)
Cost Expectations: Standard residential backflow testing typically ranges from $150 to $350, while mechanical repairs for failing components (such as relief or check valves) generally add $200 to $800 depending on the extent of the work. elecplumb.com +1
